summary: Completed comprehensive testing of drag-and-drop reorder feature for pinned stocks. All backend tests (9/9) passed. Frontend testing verified drag handles, reorder functionality, card click navigation, unpin buttons, and mobile viewport rendering.
seed_data_creation: None - used existing pinned stocks (GOOGL, AAPL, MSFT)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Drag-and-drop reorder feature fully tested. Backend PUT /api/pinned-stocks/reorder endpoint works correctly. Frontend uses @dnd-kit/core and @dnd-kit/sortable with horizontal list strategy. Drag handles use GripVertical icon with touch-none class. Order persists to backend after drag.

desktop_viewport_1920x1080.drag_reorder_works: MSFT dragged to first position, order changed from [GOOGL, AAPL, MSFT] to [MSFT, GOOGL, AAPL]
desktop_viewport_1920x1080.card_click_navigation: clicking AAPL card loads stock details

features_verified: Pinned stocks section shows drag handle (GripVertical icon) on each pinned stock card
Pinned stocks display in correct order (GOOGL, AAPL, MSFT based on backend order field)
'Drag to reorder' hint text is visible on desktop
Drag-and-drop reorder works: grabbed MSFT's drag handle and moved it to first position
After drag-and-drop, the new order persists (verified via GET /api/pinned-stocks)
Clicking a pinned stock card still navigates to the stock (not blocked by drag)
Unpin button (X) still works on each card
Backend PUT /api/pinned-stocks/reorder endpoint works with a list of tickers
Backend GET /api/pinned-stocks returns stocks sorted by order field
Mobile viewport (375x812): pinned stocks with drag handles render properly
